summary: Completed comprehensive testing of CraftBolt iteration 4 - Supplier Dashboard Redesign. All 11 backend tests passed (100%). Frontend features verified: 4 expandable accordion sections (Dostupné, Rozdělané, Dokončené, Nedokončené), progress photo upload in in-progress demands, finance summary in sidebar and completed section header, invoiced amounts display.
critical_code_review_comments: SupplierDashboard.jsx well-structured with proper accordion-style expandable sections
Finance widget correctly displayed in both sidebar and completed section header
Progress photo upload integrated with file upload API
All new backend endpoints (progress-photo, invoice, cancel-reason, finances) properly implemented with authorization checks
DemandResponse model correctly includes invoiced_amount, progress_photos, and cancellation_reason fields
seed_data_creation: Created test supplier and customer accounts, created and completed a demand with invoice amount for testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 4 features verified: 1) Supplier dashboard with 4 expandable accordion sections (available/green, in_progress/red, completed/gray, cancelled/orange), 2) POST /api/demands/{id}/progress-photo adds photos to in-progress demands, 3) POST /api/demands/{id}/invoice sets invoiced amount (supplier only), 4) POST /api/demands/{id}/cancel-reason sets cancellation reason and status, 5) GET /api/suppliers/{id}/finances returns total_income, completed_jobs, transactions, 6) Finance widget shows in sidebar and completed section header, 7) Invoiced amounts displayed on completed demand cards.
